headline: ACM publishes delay-aware Verilog-A macromodeling for photonic circuits
fact: An ACM Transactions on Design Automation of Electronic Systems accepted manuscript by Lingyun Huang and Yinghao Ye describes extracting transmission delays from photonic frequency responses, combining them with pole-residue macromodels and implementing the result in Verilog-A for electronic-photonic co-simulation. Its abstract reports evaluation on waveguides, feedforward multi-path circuits and resonant loop circuits, with compactness, speed and accuracy comparisons against conventional modeling. The publisher lists October 19 as the online manuscript date; the source check used the publisher-indexed abstract and metadata, not the full paper.

sources.title: A Delay-Aware Verilog-A Modeling and Simulation Framework for Passive Photonic Integrated Circuits — ACM
sources.summary: ACM's indexed publisher abstract and publication history identify the Verilog-A circuit macromodel, its evaluated circuit categories, and October 19 online manuscript date. Direct article access returned HTTP 403 during this check, so the full paper was not reviewed.
